initialization.prompt: Locate the visible object 'red cylinder' in the image. Return a bounding box around the visible target; coordinates are integers normalized to 0..1000 in x,y order. Abstain if the object is absent or ambiguous in this image. Return JSON {"verified":true,"box":[x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max],"reason":"..."} or {"verified":false,"reason":"..."}. Do not predict a 3D position or surface point.
initialization.system_prompt: Ground a robot target in the provided image. Do not invent missing visual evidence.
initialization.raw:
```json
{
  "verified": true,
  "box": [
    447,
    592,
    500,
    656
  ],
  "reason": "The image contains a small red cylinder located on a brown surface, positioned above a blue rectangular block. The object is clearly visible and matches the description."
}
```

surface_selection.prompt: Select a measured surface of 'red cylinder'. Image 1 is the original reference, NOT a candidate. Every subsequent image is ONE candidate, labeled with its ID. Image 2 is candidate 0, image 3 is candidate 1, and so on. All candidate images use the same enlarged context crop. In each candidate panel, ONLY pixels on the measured surface are retained; pixels outside that candidate have been replaced with black. Black background is not evidence. These unlabelled geometry proposals may include table, wall, occluders, or mixed objects. Select only a region whose bright pixels belong to the requested object, not its support furniture. A partial visible object surface is sufficient. If a region mixes target and other objects, or the target is ambiguous, abstain. Available IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3]. Return JSON {"selected_id":integer or null,"target_unambiguous":true or false,"reason":"..."}.
surface_selection.system_prompt: Choose a visually supported surface, not an object location guess. Reply with JSON only.
surface_selection.raw: {"selected_id":2,"target_unambiguous":true,"reason":"Candidate 2 shows a clear, partial view of the red cylinder's side surface, with bright red pixels belonging exclusively to the target object. Other candidates either show ambiguous or non-target surfaces (Candidate 0 shows a brown object with a red part, Candidate 1 shows a small red dot that may be a top or bottom cap, Candidate 3 shows a blue object which is not the target)."}
